title: AttachedContentNote - Data API
description: This read-only object contains all ContentNote objects associated with an object.This object is available in API version 35.0 and later.

ContentSize.description: Size of the note in bytes for notes smaller than 2 GB. In API version 66.0 and later, we recommend that you use the ContentSizeLong field even for notes smaller than 2 GB.

ContentSizeLong.description: The size of the note in bytes up to 10 GB. This field is available in API version 66.0 and later.

FileExtension.description: File extension of the attached ContentNote.

FileType.description: Type of file for the note. All notes have a file type of SNOTE.

LinkedEntityId.description: ID of the record the ContentNote is attached to.

TextPreview.description: A preview of the note, up to 255 characters.

usage:
Use this object to list all ContentNote objects attached to an object. To retrieve ContentNote objects, issue a describe call on an object, which returns a describe result for each note created or attached. You can’t directly query this object.
